evidence: The text mentions the use of X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy (XPS), X-ray Diffraction (XRD), Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM), Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM), Ellipsometry, X-ray Reflectivity (XRR), Cross-sectional FIB-SEM, Energy-Dispersive Spectroscopy (EDS), and Focused Ion Beam (FIB) for characterization.
